strings.zh: 湛蓝市是一个偏远的海滨小镇,{NEWLINE}精灵联盟为了促进湛蓝市的发展,{CLEAR}在湛蓝市的西边投资建设了度假区,{CLEAR}希望能通过度假区的旅游经济{CLEAR}带动湛蓝市一同发展。
strings.en: Cianwood City is a remote little{NEWLINE}seaside town. To help it grow, the{CLEAR}Pokémon League invested in building{CLEAR}the Resort Zone west of here.{SCROLL}They hope the tourism from the{NEWLINE}Resort Zone will drive Cianwood{CLEAR}City’s growth along with it.

strings.zh: 变得想把自己的精灵{NEWLINE}给别人看了呢！{SCROLL}想把我培育的精灵{NEWLINE}给桔梗市的朋友们{CLEAR}看看啊……
strings.en: I’ve started wanting to show my{NEWLINE}Pokémon to other people!{SCROLL}I’d love to show the Pokémon I’ve{NEWLINE}raised to my friends in Violet City...
strings.notes: US 0575/1 | RV044: meaning: US question/'a friend' replaced; zh says friends in Violet

strings.zh: 根据我多年的研究,{NEWLINE}洛奇亚确实沉睡在旋涡列岛,{CLEAR}如果类比缘朱市铃铛塔的传说,{CLEAR}唤醒洛奇亚需要海鸣铃铛和银色羽毛。{CLEAR}但我通过对海底能量的观测,{CLEAR}发现即使不用这些传说中的信物,{CLEAR}只要使用冰、火、雷三种强大的能量{CLEAR}扰乱海底的洋流,{CLEAR}同样能使洛奇亚苏醒！
strings.en: After years of research, I’m certain{NEWLINE}Lugia sleeps in the Whirl Islands.{SCROLL}Going by the Bell Tower legend of{NEWLINE}Ecruteak City, waking Lugia would take{CLEAR}the Tidal Bell and the Silver Wing.{SCROLL}But from my observations of energy{NEWLINE}under the sea, I’ve found that even{CLEAR}without those legendary tokens,{SCROLL}using three mighty energies, ice,{NEWLINE}fire and thunder, to stir up the ocean{CLEAR}currents can wake Lugia just the same!
strings.notes: ice, fire and thunder energies = the three legendary birds (cf. 0071 #68 Prof. Hale).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}！简单吧？{NEWLINE}看你的表情就知道了哦！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}! That was easy, right?{NEWLINE}I can tell just by looking at your face!
strings.notes: US 0575/3 | RV044: meaning: zh says 'easy, right?', not 'you won'

strings.zh: 嗯？难道说你……{NEWLINE}只带着１只精灵？{CLEAR}那样就麻烦了啊。{SCROLL}……　……　……{SCROLL}好吧！{NEWLINE}把我的玛瑙水母给你了！{SCROLL}才刚刚抓到的呢,{NEWLINE}因为我想似乎是个麻烦的家伙,{CLEAR}不用客气啦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Huh? Could it be that you... only have{NEWLINE}one Pokémon with you? That’s a problem.{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}All right! I’ll give you my Tentacool!{SCROLL}I only just caught it, but it{NEWLINE}seems like a bit of a handful{CLEAR}anyway. So don’t be shy!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 要给玛瑙水母{NEWLINE}起昵称吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Want to give a nickname to{NEWLINE}the Tentacool? {VAR:0200:0}
